Class CrustalGeothermalEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.procedural.CrustalGeothermalEngine
public class CrustalGeothermalEngine extends Object
Crustal Radiogenic Geothermal Heat Flux invalid input: '&' Sub-Surface Mining Gradient Engine. Models: 1. Radiogenic Decay Heat Flux (q_geo in mW/m²): Primordial + Uranium, Thorium, Potassium radiogenic decay heat. 2. Geothermal Thermal Gradient (ΔT = 30°C/km): Sub-surface temperature increases with depth. 3. Deep Mining Depth Cutoff: Limits maximum mineral extraction depth based on cooling technology era.
Version:
3.2.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
